sloka: तेषाम् अपि विशेषेण पूजा कार्या यथा क्रमम् ।ये स्युः संपूजिता सर्वे वसुभिः भोजनेन च ॥१-१३-१६॥
transliteration: teṣām api viśeṣeṇa pūjā kāryā yathā kramam ।ye syuḥ saṁpūjitā sarve vasubhiḥ bhojanena ca ॥1-13-16॥

translations.english: Then all of them approached Vasishta and said, "everything has been wellarranged in accordance with your instruction. There is no deficiency. Everything will be done as instructed by you without leaving out anything."
translations.hindi: यह यज्ञ तो सभी राजा कर सकते हैं, किन्तु इस उत्कृष्ट यज्ञ कार्य में किसी प्रकार का अपचारया किसी को कष्ट न होना चाहिए
